description: Search and filter HackList's AI & Web3 hackathons, grants, bounties and programs. Filters by keyword, type, category, format, prize, how soon it closes and how recently it was posted or updated. Duplicate listings of the same event are collapsed by default. Use get_opportunity for the full brief and eligibility details of a result.

cash_only.description: Exclude rewards that are mostly credits or in-kind.

include_closed.description: Also search past listings from HackList's archive (slower the first time).

min_prize_usd.description: Minimum headline prize in USD (approximate conversion for other currencies).

updated_within_days.description: Only listings posted or updated on HackList in the last N days.

name: search_opportunities
title: Search HackList
